resources.string: HostTap keyboard accepts text and deletion from your paired phone only while an ordinary text field is active. Password fields are excluded. Enable it in system settings, then select it. You can switch back to your usual keyboard at any time.
Optional text input: enable and select HostTap keyboard.
HostTap keyboard selected. Open a text field in the TV app, then type or dictate on your phone.
TV remote ready: directions, OK, Back and Home.
Enter the code shown by the TV in HostTap on your phone.
For native TV remote keys, select “Set up TV remote” on your paired phone.
